comments.author: @AtolRosado
comments.text:
So… why that thumbnail?

For anyone curious, that’s the department of San Miguel, the most important one of eastern El Salvador. It is also one of the most diverse departments of the country, having cold weather, mountains and forest in the north, and hot weather with beautiful beaches in the south. It has lagoons, volcanoes, ruins of an ancient Lenca city…

And speaking of cities, San Miguel is the biggest and most developed one within a ~100 miles radius.

So why should you avoid it?
